text: U.S. DEPLOYS HUNDREDS OF TROOPS TO LATIN AMERICA AS ANTI-CARTEL OPERATIONS EXPAND The Pentagon is deploying approximately 600 soldiers from the 10th Mountain Division to Latin America as Washington expands its military campaign against drug cartels, according to U.S. military officials cited by the New York Times. text: AI DEBT FEARS SURGE AS TECH DEFAULT INSURANCE HITS RECORD HIGHS The cost of insuring against defaults by major U.S. tech companies has reached record highs as investors worry about AI spending, rising debt and higher interest rates. CoreWeave ($CRWV ) is under the most pressure, with credit markets pricing in an implied 63% probability of default within five years. Default insurance costs have also risen for Oracle ($ORCL ), Nvidia ($NVDA), Amazon ($AMZN), Alphabet ($GOOGL) and Meta ($META). The key concern: Investors are questioning whether AI companies can generate enough profits to repay their growing debts.

The key risk: AI technology could succeed while investors suffer from overinvestment and declining returns.
